title: Kevin McKay, Fab Massimo, Chantal Lewis-Brown - How Will I Know

lines.l: Look at me too, my eyes, takes me to the clouds above
Oh, I lose control, can't seem to get enough
When I wake from dreaming, tell me is it really love?
How will I know, how will I know, how will I know, how will I know, how will I know if
he really loves me, I'll tell you guys with every heartbeat, I'll fall in love with
